facts.text: The hotel occupies a turn-of-the-century industrial building built in 1932.
facts.excerpt: preserves the character of a turn-of-the-century industrial building built in 1932 while remaining an integral part of the Georgetown cityscape

facts.text: The hotel was built on the site of an incinerator and is a National Historic Landmark.
facts.excerpt: The fantastic conversion—it was built on the site of an incinerator—is now a National Historic Landmark

facts.text: The redbrick hotel has a smokestack and mixes the Potomac's industrial history with a sleek, modern design.
facts.excerpt: This redbrick hotel with a smokestack mixes the Potomac’s industrial history with a sleek, modern design

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Georgetown, just steps from M Street and Wisconsin Avenue.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Georgetown, just steps from M Street and Wisconsin Avenue

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Potomac River and is near Georgetown University and the C&O Canal.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Potomac River, our luxury hotel near Georgetown University and the C&O Canal

facts.text: Rooms overlook the neighborhood or the Potomac River, and suites feature patios, dining spaces and fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: Rooms overlook the neighborhood or Potomac River, and suites feature patios, dining spaces and fireplaces.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a private terrace with lounge seating and a private fire-pit.
facts.excerpt: Step outside onto the private terrace and take in the scenic views of the city, appointed with comfortable lounge seating and a private fire-pit.

facts.text: The Ambassador Suite is inspired by Georgetown row houses and has a personal study off the main living room.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the row houses of Georgetown, the Ambassador Suite is designed to feel like a residence featuring a personal study off the main living room.

facts.text: The Living Room has exposed brick, a wood-burning fireplace and lounge seating.
facts.excerpt: featuring exposed brick, a dramatic wood burning fireplace, luxurious lounge seating, and inspired décor

facts.text: Degrees Bistro serves contemporary American dishes among brick walls and steel beams, with the wine bar in the center of the room.
facts.excerpt: Degrees Bistro pairs contemporary American dishes with brick walls and steel beams; the wine bar sits in the center of the room.

facts.text: Baked Alaska is served every evening in The Living Room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Baked Alaska, prepared by our expert culinary team, every evening at 5pm in The Living Room.

facts.text: The spa has five treatment rooms, including one couple's room, and uses an ESPA product line.
facts.excerpt: an intimate, hidden oasis that boasts five treatment rooms, including one couple’s room, and features a new menu with an exclusive ESPA product line

facts.text: The spa has relaxation lounges with saunas and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: complemented by relaxation lounges with saunas and steam rooms

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment, Peloton spin bikes and a wall bar by PENT.
facts.excerpt: Technogym equipment, Peloton spin bikes, wall bar by PENT

facts.text: The hotel lends Ritz-Carlton Cruisers, city-friendly bikes for getting to attractions such as the National Mall and the Smithsonian Museums.
facts.excerpt: Ritz-Carlton Cruisers, city-friendly bikes that easily travel to D.C.’s most iconic attractions, including Georgetown University, the National Mall, and the Smithsonian Museums

facts.text: Children are welcomed with a red wagon of stuffed animals they can take home as a souvenir.
facts.excerpt: Our lobby staff loads a red wagon with stuffed animals that children can pick to take home with them as a souvenir from their visit.

facts.text: Pets are welcome: one dog or cat up to 25 lbs per room, with a non-refundable fee per stay.
facts.excerpt: 1 dog/cat 25 lbs max per room with USD 165 non-refundable fee per room per stay

facts.text: Parking is by valet only.
facts.excerpt: Overnight Valet Parking $75 USD per night, Day Parking $45 USD per day. Exclusive of tax.

facts.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle.
facts.excerpt: No, The Ritz-Carlton Georgetown, Washington, D.C. does not have an airport shuttle to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.

facts.text: Suite bathrooms have Diptyque Paris amenities.
facts.excerpt: Bathroom amenities (Diptyque Paris)

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel as a Readers' Choice Awards winner for 2024 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2024, 2025
